title: ikn-library: nature-inspired metaheuristics with applied modules for cheminformatics and bioinformatics
description:
A Python library of nature-inspired metaheuristic algorithms together with the applied components needed to point them at real data: wrapper feature selection, hyperparameter optimization, ensemble weight optimization, evolutionary undersampling, and loaders for gene expression, molecular and drug-target datasets.

Every algorithm implements the same interface, and every algorithm is benchmarked under rotation and translation of the objective, with the resulting behaviour documented per algorithm.
